period.note: Warmup indicators use pre-period bars; trading/equity normalized from 2023-09-24. Last closed kline used.

gate.oos_definition: Fixed-parameter segmented test: split the 3y evaluation window into 6 contiguous ~6-month folds; count folds where strategy return > buy&hold return. NOT a re-optimizing walk-forward.

scoring_method.minmax: For cagr_3y, ret_1y, excess=(ret_3y-bh_ret_3y), and maxdd_quality=(-abs(maxdd)): norm=(x-min)/(max-min) among gate passers; if only one passer or max==min, norm=1.0

meta.full_period_note: full_period uses longest Binance history available per symbol; OOS is fixed-parameter 6-segment split (same definition as 3y), not re-optimizing WF. Costs 20bps one-way.

core_dual_gate_scan.source: s3 results.json saved buckets only (not full 946 raw dump — those were not persisted per-combo)
core_dual_gate_scan.honest: No strategy among 16 persisted s3 named results passes BOTH unified-3y gate and full-period gate under 20bps.

params.note: original s2 backtest ATR=SMA; no reset_below_hi
trail still applied; stop_m=0 disables initial stop distance→ use wide; actually stop_m=0 makes stop=entry; set stop_m very large
s1/s2 ema_trend_hold family: wide stop, no meaningful trail
